# cpp-httplib

Vendored, unmodified `httplib.h` and MIT license from
[yhirose/cpp-httplib v0.56.0](https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib/tree/v0.56.0).
The build needs no network download. This project compiles the HTTP layer as
C++11 and does **not** enable `CPPHTTPLIB_OPENSSL_SUPPORT`; httplib therefore
does not impose a TLS/OpenSSL upgrade on the legacy cryptographic core.
